We're settling the score on Geonosis once and for all.|Obi-Wan Kenobi|{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20091103fd/index.html|text=Fan Days Script: A Prelude to "Point Rain"}}}} The '''Second Battle of Geonosis''' took place at the start of the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] launched a full-scale [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] invasion of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] to shut down several [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[Droid factory|foundries]] that [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]] had built there. Following [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] [[Mission to Cato Neimoidia/Legends|discovery]] of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] factories, the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] dispatched a massive [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-led detachment of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] to retake Geonosis and halt the facilities' production of battle droids. Tasked with the challenge of landing on the planet and establishing a staging area, the Jedi mounted a three-pronged attack on the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] defenses in what became known as the '''battle of Point Rain''', with [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] each leading an assault force. After establishing a landing zone at [[Point Rain/Legends|Point Rain]], a site close to the factories' [[Geonosis ray shield generator/Legends|Ray Shield Fortress]] [[Ray shield generator/Legends|generator]], the Republic [[Army/Legends|army]] regrouped and disabled the factories' [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shield]], making way for the rest of the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] forces to safely land. While Poggle attempted to retake Point Rain and his Ray Shield Fortress, his [[Geonosis primary droid foundry/Legends|main droid foundry]] was targeted by the Jedi. In order to eliminate the factory, [[General/Legends|Generals]] Skywalker and [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] battled the facility's droid defenses in open warfare while their respective [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]], sneaked into the facility via the [[Geonosian catacombs/Legends|catacombs]] beneath it. As their Masters battled Poggle's army—including several newly designed [[Separatist super-tank prototype/Legends|super tanks]]—on the bridge leading to the factory, the Padawans' infiltration of the foundry was cut short when they were intercepted by Poggle and his [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|tactical droid]], [[TX-21/Legends|TX-21]]. With their [[Thermal detonator/Legends|explosive charges]] stolen, Tano and Offee used a super [[Tank/Legends|tank]] to blow up the facility's [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]] and collapse the factory from the inside. Skywalker and Unduli rescued their Padawans from the debris once the foundry had fallen. Despite the Republic's destruction of other key factories, Poggle remained at large, having escaped his primary foundry before its eradication. As the Jedi undertook the cleanup of Geonosis, they launched a campaign to find and apprehend Poggle. Unduli spearheaded the search and followed Poggle to the abandoned [[Progate Temple/Legends|Progate Temple]], where she was captured by the archduke and taken to the lair of Geonosian [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Karina the Great/Legends|Karina the Great]] in the catacombs below. Tracking Unduli's last known location, Kenobi and Skywalker set out with a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] to rescue her. Battling hordes of "[[Zombie/Legends|undead]]" Geonosian warriors who were being reanimated by the queen's [[Brain worm/Legends|brain worm]] [[Parasite/Legends|parasites]], the Jedi and their [[Troop/Legends|troops]] found Unduli in Karina's lair. Although Karina wished to induct Unduli and her comrades into her ranks of mind-controlled warriors, Kenobi, Skywalker, and their men were able to save Unduli and take Poggle into custody. The Jedi and their troops destroyed much of the queen's lair during their escape, killing Karina the Great and burying her warriors beneath the temple, and the Republic's recapture of Geonosis was secured. ==Prelude== ===The new droid foundries=== {{Quote|This investment by the Banking Clan will create unimaginable new war profits. The largest droid factory ever built.''"
"''As long as the Republic doesn't find out.|Rush Clovis and Lott Dod conspire on investing in Poggle the Lesser's primary droid foundry|audio=NewWarProfits-SS.flac|{{TCW|Senate Spy}}}} At the start of [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|opening battle]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] earlier that [[Standard year/Legends|year]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]],{{Film|II}} the native [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]]''[[The Clone Wars: Planets in Peril]]'' began building a series of new [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[Droid factory|foundries]] on their [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world to expand the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] with thousands of more [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Troop/Legends|troops]]. Because the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] had captured the planet at the war's outset, the facilities were kept secret to protect them from the Republic, which greatly underestimated the Geonosians' resistance and their loyalty to the Separatists. [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]] himself oversaw the foundries' progress, particularly the rebuilding{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20091103/index.html|text=The Action Intensifies in "Landing at Point Rain"}} of the [[Geonosis primary droid foundry/Legends|primary droid foundry]], which was intended to surpass in size the [[Geonosis droid factories/Legends|original factories]] that had fallen during the First Battle of Geonosis. Poggle himself had been humiliated during the First Battle of Geonosis and viewed the factory as his redemption,{{CN|url=tv_shows/starwars/?episodeID=8a25059624c454dc0124c642fcd50009|text=Dataclip: Weapons Factory|na=video file}} and he also hoped to exact his revenge on the Republic for the occupation of his planet and the destruction of many of his factories. [[File:Cato_foundry_holo.png|thumb|left|250px|Senators Clovis and Dod meet with Poggle the Lesser on Cato Neimoidia.]] Poggle's factories churned out thousands of battle droids a day,''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures: The Official Guide to the Virtual World]]'' and the units were sold to the Confederacy for its war machine.''[[The Clone Wars: Jedi Heroes]]'' The [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] invested substantial funds in the primary foundry, but after the financial burden became too big to bear, the Banking Clan took on another Separatist-loyal corporation, the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], as a co-investor.{{FactFile2014|9|CLO 1-2|Rush Clovis}} As Republic [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]] of the Trade Federation and Senator [[Rush Clovis/Legends|Rush Clovis]] of the Banking Clan delegation prepared to [[Mission to Cato Neimoidia/Legends|meet]] on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], where Dod resided, to discuss their investments in the foundry, the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]—correctly suspecting Clovis of involvement in a Separatist conspiracy—recruited Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] to [[Spy/Legends|spy]] on Clovis. Amidala, who had previously been romantically involved with Clovis, agreed to the mission and was able to secure a personal invitation to accompany Clovis to Cato Neimoidia. With her secret [[Marriage/Legends|husband]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], as her [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]], Amidala went with Clovis on his trip. At [[Lott Dod's palace/Legends|Dod's palace]], Clovis met in secret with Dod and Poggle the Lesser, who had also arrived to participate in the deliberations. Dod and Poggle both attempted to negotiate for greater shares in the investment, but Clovis refused to change the terms of the agreement. However, Dod, witnessing Clovis's affection for Amidala, secretly [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]] the latter with a dose of lethal [[manax-root poison]]''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Official Episode Guide Series 1 & 2]]'' to force the Banking Clan senator to change his mind. Shortly after stealing a disc containing the droid foundry's tactical coordinates from a [[Holoprojector/Legends|hologram projector]] in the palace's library, Amidala fainted from the effects of the poison. Clovis threatened Dod with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and secured the antidote to the poison, which he gave to Skywalker. Accordingly, Skywalker helped Amidala to her [[J-type star skiff]] and administered the medicine, then departed from Cato Neimoidia with Amidala and the disc. Clovis was left behind to face Dod, Poggle, and a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]]. ===Preparations for an invasion=== {{Quote|What I worry about is the way this war seems to be drawing out with no end in sight.''"
"''Which it is why it is crucial that our invasion of Geonosis meets with success.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Ki-Adi-Mundi|audio=NoEndInSight-LaPR.flac|}} Following Skywalker and Amidala's return to the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and the report of their findings to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] High Council, [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] was dispatched with a contingent of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] to reconnoiter Geonosis. Upon arrival in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the world, Rex and his men were unable to establish contact with the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] on the planet's surface but confirmed from preliminary scans that droid foundries, some of them close to completion and others already operational, were being constructed in the world's northern and southern hemispheres. Rex sent his report back to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] with the advisement that a full-scale invasion would be necessary to retake Geonosis. Reviewing the report, the Jedi Council decided to send [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] and [[Senior Jedi General]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] to lead the Grand [[Army/Legends|Army's]] attack on the droid foundries. Since the facilities were a significant threat to the Republic's safety, retaking Geonosis would be essential to the Republic war effort. [[General/Legends|Generals]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and Skywalker, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]],{{TCWA|Starfighter}} and Skywalker's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], were meanwhile assigned to reinforce the planet [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]], which had been [[Battle of Dorin|attacked]] by a Separatist [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] led by the Confederate General [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] in an effort to keep the Jedi's attention away from Geonosis. [[File:GeonosisPlanning.png|thumb|right|250px|The Jedi plan their invasion of Geonosis.]] The Republic forces spent much [[Time/Legends|time]] in preparation for the assault on Geonosis. Mundi and his [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone commander]], [[Jet/Legends|Jet]], spent [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] studying intelligence reports about Geonosis's defenses Jet even customized his [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|clone armor]] for the battle.{{TCWA|set=Commander Jet}} Mundi, Kenobi, and Unduli were eventually dispatched to Geonosis with a massive invasion fleet consisting of [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] and [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]]. After the invasion force had arrived in Geonosian [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and entered the planet's orbit, Skywalker, Tano, and Yularen—who had successfully repelled Grievous's forces from Dorin—rendezvoused with the fleet, and Skywalker and Tano joined Mundi and Kenobi on the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] at the head of the fleet. With their [[Starship/Legends|ships]] in position, the four Jedi opened a communication to the Republic's [[Outer Rim Command Center/Legends|Outer Rim Command]] and conferred with [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and Jedi Generals Unduli, [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]. Based on intelligence they had received, Mundi and Kenobi concluded that Poggle the Lesser was holed up within his primary droid factory, which, thanks to his [[Geonosis ray shield generator/Legends|Ray Shield Fortress]], was being protected by a massive [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shield]]. With their primary target being the [[Ray shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] at the Ray Shield Fortress, the Jedi planned to execute a three-pronged attack on the Geonosian defenses. Mundi and Jet were to lead the northern advance, while Kenobi and [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Marshal Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] commenced the central push. Skywalker, Tano, and Rex, meanwhile, would execute the southern assault with their forces from the 501st [[Legion/Legends|Legion]]. The troops would rendezvous at [[Point Rain/Legends|Point Rain]], a site that was just a short distance away from the Ray Shield Fortress; there, they would establish a staging area before eliminating the shield generator and setting up a defensive perimeter to their temporary base. Although Tano noted that the defenses were heavily fortified, pointing out a large wall [[Armor/Legends|armored]] with numerous [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] emplacements, Skywalker believed that their approach would not lead them to the barricade. With their planning complete, the four Jedi split up to mobilize their forces for the coming battle. As the Republic forces were soon to discover, the Geonosians were better prepared to defend their homeworld a second time from the Grand Army. ==The battle== ===The Republic invasion=== ====Rough landing on Geonosis==== {{Quote|We've got no air cover. Two generals on the ground beyond our position. And a mess of bugs surrounding us. The enemy was more than prepared for our attack, sir. They knew our every move.''"
"''Well, I'm sure General Skywalker and General Mundi will make it to our position. We just have to make sure we're still here when they arrive.|Cody and Obi-Wan Kenobi|audio=StillHereWhenTheyArrive-LaPR.flac|}} The Republic's [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] descended upon Geonosis and began to disgorge [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]], [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]], and [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/carrier/Legends|LAAT carriers]] ferrying [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcers]] to the surface in heavy numbers. While [[Cloning/Legends|Clone]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Breaker]] and a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]] led the Y-wing [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] squadrons in repelling groups of Geonosian [[Nantex-class territorial defense starfighter/Legends|''Nantex''-class territorial defense starfighters]], Kenobi's assault force was the first to take flight, with Kenobi leading the way in his [[Bad Kitty/Legends|gunship]]. Kenobi and his gunships were met with heavy resistance from Geonosian [[J-1 semi-autonomous proton cannon]]s and [[LR1K sonic cannon/Legends|LR1K sonic cannon]] emplacements below, as well as the ''Nantex''-class starfighters from above, but they were able to push through with covering fire from the Republic Y-wing starfighters, which also targeted the Separatist [[Gunner/Legends|gunners]] on the ground. With Kenobi's forces underway, Skywalker's detachment—including Rex and Tano—departed shortly afterward, followed by the assault group led by Mundi and Jet from Yularen's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']]. Once all three strike forces had launched, Yularen recalled his fighter squadrons to the Republic's [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]] for new orders. The gunship carrying Skywalker, Tano, and Rex was one of the first to be shot down, but the group managed to break free from the wreckage and use the fallen craft as cover from the nearby Geonosian gunners and [[J-10 dual blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]]. Mundi, meanwhile, ordered Cody to land the AT-TE [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] shortly before Mundi's [[Separatist Nightmare/Legends|own gunship]] fell to heavy fire as well. [[File:GeonosisDifficultLanding.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Republic gunships are ravaged by Geonosian gunners while attempting to land.]] Cody landed with his men and AT-TE walkers to be greeted by incoming ''Nantex''-class fighters. Although Cody advised Kenobi not to land because of the danger posed by the Separatist fighters, Kenobi and his gunship were forced down when the craft was targeted by the Geonosians. The gunship hit the surface and skidded across the ground before coming to a stop, leaving only Kenobi and trooper [[Trapper (clone trooper)/Legends|Trapper]] alive. An injured Mundi and Jet pulled themselves out of the remains of their gunship, which was just one of many to have been shot down in the area. Jet reported that Kenobi's forces had been the only ones to reach the landing zone, while Skywalker's AT-TE walkers had been decimated in his ongoing [[Lightfight|firefight]] with the Geonosians; Jet noted that Skywalker would continue to press on to the rendezvous point to meet with Kenobi. Mundi ordered the injured men among his own [[Special ops clone trooper/Legends|special ops]] forces to be loaded onto the AT-TE walkers with the objective of pressing on to make for a nearby bridge and join the rest of the troops at the rendezvous site. As all of the Republic's main strike teams were dispatched to battle the Geonosians, Breaker and the Jedi Knight were tasked with another mission. They and an elite crew were to take an LAAT/i gunship behind enemy lines to destroy a key Separatist installation; in doing so, they would sever Geonosian communications in the area and help to ease Geonosian retaliation to the Republic's primary assault. The elite gunship battled through enemy droid forces—including [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|DSD1 dwarf spider droids]], [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transports]], [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]]-equipped [[B2-RP battle droid/Legends|B2-RP battle droids]], [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]], [[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|''Hyena''-class bombers]], and [[Droid tri-fighter/Legends|droid tri-fighters]]—before reaching and destroying the Geonosian communications facility. Elsewhere, while overseeing the battle against the Geonosians in the area alongside Skywalker and Tano, Rex contacted Cody to request reinforcements for Skywalker but found that Kenobi would be unable to give support, as Kenobi's gunship had been shot down. [[File:CloneFlamethrowers-LaPR.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Mundi's flame troopers raze through the Geonosians to open a path through the cave.]] Once Skywalker and Tano had tossed their primed detonator–full backpacks into the hatches, they and Rex jumped off the wall shortly before it exploded. It does not look good.|Ki-Adi-Mundi and Anakin Skywalker|}} Skywalker, Tano, Rex, and their squad, who were making their way to Point Rain, happened upon the clifftop cave where Mundi's forces were just finishing off the smoldering Geonosians. When the Geonosians stopped the Republic's advance toward the droid factories, Yularen and the recovering Kenobi sent the Jedi Knight to clear out the resistance that was halting the clones' assault. The Geonosian archduke meanwhile dispatched a [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] of droids to retake the heavily damaged Ray Shield Fortress from Republic control, as putting the facility back online would cut off Skywalker's forces. Unwilling to let the Separatists overrun the fortress and subsequently break the Republic's supply lines, Breaker and the Jedi Knight mobilized their forces to defend the facility. However, the Geonosians were unable to retake the Ray Shield Fortress, and Breaker and the Jedi Knight forced them to recall their depleted troops. ====Assault on the main foundry==== {{Quote|How do we keep the Geonosians occupied while someone else is setting the bombs?''"

That task will be carried out by you and I, Skywalker, while the destruction of the factory falls to the Padawans.|Ahsoka Tano, Anakin Skywalker, and Luminara Unduli|}} As Poggle's primary droid foundry neared completion, Skywalker's forces formed a staging area a short way from the only bridge that crossed the deep canyon isolating the heavily fortified installation. Anticipating stiff Geonosian resistance, Republic [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] dispatched Luminara Unduli and her Padawan, [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]], with reinforcements for Skywalker's assault. Leading the way in their [[Dooku Boot/Legends|gunship]], Unduli, Offee, and Clone Commander [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|Gree]] arrived at the Republic's staging area with more troops and gunships, and Unduli and Offee met with Skywalker and Tano to finalize a plan for the impending attack on the droid foundry. Although Skywalker had been preparing for a direct assault on the factory via the bridge, Unduli proposed an alternative plan that would minimize their casualties: using the [[Geonosian catacombs/Legends|catacombs]] under the facility, a team could infiltrate the building and plant explosives at its main [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]], thus effectively destroying the foundry from the inside. As Unduli had already had her Padawan memorize all 200 of the labyrinth's internal junctions, the mission to infiltrate the droid factory fell to Tano and Offee. Skywalker and Unduli, meanwhile, would launch a forward assault on the facility's main entrance to distract Poggle and allow the Padawans to complete their assignment. With their strategy in place, the Jedi set their plan into motion, synchronizing [[Chronometer/Legends|chronometers]] so that the Padawans' progress could be monitored. [[File:GeonosisCrossfire.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Geonosians mount a defense of the primary droid foundry.]] While Tano and Offee began to descend the chasm in front of the droid factory to reach the entry point to the catacombs at the bottom of the canyon, Skywalker, Unduli, Rex, and Gree mobilized their men and marched their troops and AT-TE walkers toward the bridge parade-style. Despite their risky lack of cover, Skywalker and Unduli intended to make their frontal assault tempting enough to draw the factory's droid defenders into a fight. With ten [[Garrison/Legends|garrisons]] of new droids ready, Poggle and TX-21 took the bait and deployed a large army of B1 and B2 battle droids to defend the foundry. As Skywalker and Unduli led their men to charge the droids, they found themselves confronted by groups of flying Geonosians launching a surprise attack from several spires behind them, and they were caught in a crossfire. In the canyon, Tano and Offee made it to the other side of the trough, where Offee cut a hole in the canyon wall and opened the entrance to the catacombs. The two Padawans made their way through the dense labyrinth and through a room of sleeping Geonosian warriors, unaware that they were being followed by a [[Unidentified Geonosian spy/Legends|Geonosian]] whom they had accidentally awoken. Skywalker and Unduli continued to cut through the opposing battle droids, and trooper [[Buzz/Legends|Buzz]] used a [[Z-6 rotary blaster cannon/Legends|Z-6 rotary blaster cannon]] to take out the airborne Geonosian insurgents. With the appearance of several droideka squads, Rex sent trooper [[Draa/Legends|Draa]] forward with a [[Missile launcher/Legends|rocket launcher]], and Draa quickly destroyed the droids. Trooper Boil, meanwhile, piloted an [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|All Terrain Recon Transport]] against the Geonosians. The Geonosians' advance forces were further depleted by heavy fire from the Republic's AT-TE walkers. In response, Poggle authorized TX-21 to send out twenty units of their newly developed [[Separatist super-tank prototype/Legends|super tanks]]. The ray shielded vehicles were deployed from the foundry, and despite the Republic forces' attempt to halt the tanks' advance with [[AV-7 Antivehicle Cannon/Legends|AV-7 Antivehicle Cannons]] manned by [[Clone gunner/Legends|clone tank gunners]], Skywalker, Unduli, and their men were unable to stop the shielded tanks' approach. With the battle turning in the Republic's favor, Poggle and TX-21 made one last attempt to outflank Skywalker's forces, sending out a droid army to cut off his battle group. Once the Separatists' attack route had been identified, Captain Breaker and his Jedi Knight compatriot set out with a Republic assault force to intercept Poggle's army; the Republic's engineers provided an array of turret defense platforms for use in combating the incoming droids. After breaching the Republic defenses with armored droid tanks, mobile shield generators, starfighter squadrons, and a multitude of ground troops, TX-21 deployed a super tank to compromise the Republic's position. Although the tough super tank did significant damage to the Republic's turret emplacements, Breaker and the Jedi Knight were able to destroy the droids and the super tank before the latter could move on to target Skywalker's forces, and Poggle's deployed army was defeated. In the meantime, Tano and Offee arrived at the primary foundry's control room and planted their thermal detonator charges around the large main generator. Learning of the two Jedi's presence from the Geonosian spy, Poggle and TX-21 personally took a squad of Geonosian warriors and a super tank to greet the intruders. After activating their explosives, the Padawans' escape was cut short by the arrival of the Geonosian archduke and his super tank. Outside the foundry, Skywalker and Unduli learned from their chronometer readings that Tano and Offee had placed and activated the bombs. Immediately thereafter, the Separatist tanks released a barrage of rockets that annihilated the Republic's artillery line and AT-TE walkers, dealing heavy casualties. While the Geonosians and their super tank kept Tano and Offee occupied in the control room, other Geonosian warriors collected the primed explosives from around the reactor. Poggle entrusted TX-21 and his troops to thwart the Jedi's plan while he departed. [[File:Geonosis-ReactorBattle.png|thumb|left|250px|Tano and Offee are intercepted by TX-21 and a Geonosian squad at the foundry's reactor.]] After destroying TX-21 with an explosive charge but barely putting a scratch on the super tank, Tano made to retrieve the bombs from the Geonosians, jumping and hanging onto two of the flying warriors before they could escape from the Padawans. However, the Geonosians knocked Tano against the reactor, temporarily rendering her unconscious. Forced to defend the fallen Tano from the super tank's laser fire, Offee was unable to prevent the Geonosians from escaping into a hatch with the primed bombs. Meanwhile, Skywalker and Unduli ordered Rex, Gree, and their men to fall back in order to lure the tanks onto the bridge, which the two Jedi Generals intended to collapse to eliminate the tanks. The clones' retreat baited the tanks onto the pass, and Skywalker and Unduli swung hand-over-hand under the bridge and across its underbelly, planting explosives at key points along its length. Reaching the other side of the bridge, Skywalker and Unduli detonated the charges, destroying the span and sending the tanks into the abyss below. Even with the arrival of evacuation ships, Skywalker refused to leave without his Padawan, who was unresponsive to his transmissions. The two Jedi Generals' refusal to retreat forced them to face more B1 battle droids from Poggle's foundry. Inside the control room, Offee cut her way into the super tank and disabled its battle droid operators, commandeering the vehicle and saving Tano from being killed by the vehicle's cannon. A revived Tano joined Offee inside the tank, where the pair contemplated their dilemma: without the bombs, they would be unable to destroy the foundry and complete their crucial mission. Tano and Offee chose to instead use the super tank to fire at the generator, despite knowing that they would be unable to escape the subsequent explosion. Once Tano had relayed that decision to Skywalker and Unduli, who were battling the droids outside, she and Offee opened fire on the reactor, causing a massive chain of explosions to bring the foundry down. Unable to help their Padawans, a dismayed Skywalker and Unduli took cover as their droid adversaries were crushed by the debris from the collapsing droid foundry. After the dust had settled and the smoke had cleared, Skywalker desperately tried to contact Tano with his comlink, to no avail. Determined to rescue the buried Padawans from under the layers of rubble, Skywalker ordered the Republic's LAAT carriers to begin lifting the debris to search for Tano and Offee. Trapped with Offee in the super tank deep below the surface with a limited supply of air, Tano used a [[Power cell/Legends|power cell]] to boost her communicator's reception and signal Skywalker to their position. Skywalker, Unduli, and a squad of clones quickly proceeded to the indicated area, and with time running out, Skywalker and Unduli used the Force to levitate the heavy debris away from the Padawans' super tank. The freed Tano and Offee emerged from the wreckage, coughing and grimy but alive, and were reunited with their Masters. Following their success and ordeal in destroying the foundry, Tano and Offee were sent back to the fleet for some much-needed rest and accompanied a [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] of LAAT/i gunships ferrying the Republic's wounded troops back for treatment. ===The Geonosians' threat=== {{Quote|Anakin, the queen took Luminara hostage. She wanted a Jedi, now she has two more. I want to know what she's after.''"
"''Well, when this doesn't go as planned, which it won't, I'll be ready.''"
"''That is ''so'' reassuring.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker|audio=SoReassuring-LoT.flac|}} Besides putting an end to Poggle's primary droid foundry, the Republic forces were also able to destroy other key factories, albeit at a heavy cost to their troops. The Republic's [[Tango Company/Legends|Tango Company]] was among the clone units to be involved in the battle. As Unduli and a recovered Kenobi began a cleanup of Geonosis, they mounted an intense campaign to find Poggle, who had escaped his primary foundry's destruction and was evading the Republic's efforts to locate and apprehend him. Unduli and trooper Buzz set out on [[BARC speeder/Legends|BARC speeders]] and picked up the trail of the fleeing Geonosian archduke, who was en route to the Progate Temple with a squad of battle droids and two [[Royal guard (Geonosian)/Legends|royal Geonosian guards]] aboard an Armored Assault Tank, bringing along several crates of munitions. [[File:UnduliBuzzProgate.png|thumb|right|250px|Unduli and Buzz search the Progate Temple for Poggle the Lesser.]] Unduli and Buzz followed Poggle through the sandstorm and into the temple, where the pair reported back to Kenobi, Mundi, and Skywalker, who were overseeing the Republic fleet at their staging area elsewhere on the planet. Once the sandstorm had lifted, Skywalker, Kenobi, and Cody took a [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] of clone troops in a [[The Bug Stomper/Legends|gunship]] to the Progate Temple to find and rescue Unduli. There, Cody found Buzz's dead body, and Kenobi chanced upon Unduli's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Noting his belief that Poggle could not have defeated a Jedi, Skywalker noticed a statue of a "bizarre Geonosian," which Kenobi speculated to be of the long-rumored Geonosian queen. Intent on finding Unduli, Skywalker, Kenobi, Cody, and their men entered the caverns through the temple, using their lightsabers and headlamps to light the way. Cody's wrist-mounted trackers led the platoon into a tunnel that penetrated deepest into the planet's crust. Meanwhile, Unduli, who had been placed in [[Binders/Legends|binders]] and was being dragged through the catacombs by Poggle and a group of Geonosian drones, regained consciousness and was able to break free of her captors. Fighting the Geonosian warriors in [[Unarmed combat/Legends|close combat]], Unduli was unable to defeat the already dead guards, and she used her [[Imagecaster/Legends|imagecaster]] holoprojector to hail Kenobi. Unduli urged him and his troops to abandon their search for her, but she was subdued once more after relaying her message. Instead of taking Unduli's advice, Kenobi and Skywalker led their men deeper into the caverns and pressed on, only to encounter and be surrounded by a horde of the Geonosian zombie warriors themselves. The Jedi and clones opened fire on their adversaries but were unable to stop the [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoids]]. With his men outnumbered and taking losses, Kenobi ordered the platoon to take out the tunnel's supports and retreat, seeing it as the only way to halt the Geonosians' advance. The Jedi and their troops escaped from the zombie warriors for the time being. Kenobi and Skywalker grimly noted the drone warriors' apparent immunity to all of their attacks and resolved to request reinforcements from Mundi. Because they were too deep underground to get a comlink signal, Kenobi sent trooper [[Gearshift/Legends|Gearshift]] and [[Gearshift's comrade|another clone]] to backtrack to the surface and contact Mundi. The two troopers did not get far before being attacked and killed by the Geonosian zombies. Hearing the pair's screams, Kenobi, Skywalker, Cody, and the rest of the platoon ran to help their comrades but arrived too late to save them, instead finding their slain bodies. Although Skywalker wanted to go to the surface himself to hail Mundi, Kenobi believed that they could not divide their troops again and noted that time was running out for Unduli. The captive Unduli, meanwhile, woke up to find herself suspended in a [[Containment field/Legends|containment field]] next to the throne of Queen Karina the Great, who was in the process of reproducing more Geonosian drones from her [[Ovipositor|undulating and large egg sac]], aided to by the reanimated warriors of her [[Stalgasin hive/Legends|hive]]. Kenobi, Skywalker, and Cody finally found the royal chamber and spied on the proceedings from the shadows. Using his [[Infrared/Legends|infrared]] headlamp in the dark room, Cody located Unduli next to the throne and Poggle in conversation with the Queen. Skywalker was set to mount a full-on attack on the Geonosians, but Kenobi, who was after the reasons behind the queen's abduction of Unduli, devised a different plan. The Jedi set up their clone troopers around the room's perimeter, intending to have their men use their headlamps to temporarily blind the dark-dwelling Geonosians and create enough confusion so that they could rescue Unduli when the appropriate moment presented itself. [[File:JediEscapeKarina.png|thumb|left|250px|Skywalker and Unduli escape from Queen Karina's lair with Poggle the Lesser in tow.]] While Cody stealthily moved the men into place, Kenobi and Skywalker marched straight into the throne room and through the lines of Geonosians zombies to speak with Karina. Kenobi spoke with the queen and told her that her rule was at an end, but the shrieking queen refused to recognize the Jedi's authority. Her subordinates took the Jedi's lightsabers from them, and Karina then revealed her intentions: instead of seeking the Jedi's elimination, she wished to possess them using her [[Brain/Legends|brain]] [[Worm/Legends|worms]], as the Jedi would make valuable additions to her army of warriors. As Poggle placed one of the parasites on Unduli so that the worms' power could be demonstrated, Kenobi signaled Cody and the clones to attack. The troopers blasted their headlamps on the Geonosians and temporarily blinded them, allowing Kenobi and Skywalker to retrieve their lightsabers from the drones with the Force. While Kenobi himself took Unduli's brain worm as a sample for study, Skywalker freed Unduli and returned her lightsaber to her. The Jedi confronted Poggle, and Skywalker shackled the Geonosian archduke in a pair of binders and brought him along with them before knocking Kenobi's worm sample out of his hand and crushing it beneath his boot. Once Kenobi, Skywalker, and Unduli had fled the cave with the detained Poggle, the clone troopers provided cover for them and blasted the chamber's supports, trapping the Geonosians there under layers of rubble and killing Queen Karina the Great. The warrior drones continued to follow the group, and as the clones continued to focus their fire at their pursuers, the Jedi headed to escape the catacombs to the surface. The Republic platoon climbed an air shaft out of the caverns, and the Geonosians pursing the squad were knocked back down and crushed under falling rocks. A geyser of dust billowed through the vertical passage and spewed Kenobi, Skywalker, Unduli, Poggle, Cody, and the remaining clone troopers out of the catacombs. The group evacuated the temple shortly before it collapsed. With the ordeal over and Archduke Poggle the Lesser in Republic custody, the Jedi hoped that the queen's deadly brain worms had been buried with her under the temple, though that was not the case. ==Aftermath== {{Quote|The Republic must begin debriefing Poggle right away if we're to get useful intelligence from him.''"
"''Master, I suggest we let our Padawans handle the supply mission.|Luminara Unduli and Anakin Skywalker|audio=MustBeginDebriefing-BI.flac|}} [[File:JediEscortGeonosis.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Jedi prepare to escort Poggle the Lesser to Coruscant for trial and interrogation.]] The assault on Geonosis finally resulted in success, and the Republic was able to recapture the Separatist-allied world, ensuring that its droid factories would no longer fortify the Confederacy's troop lines. The Jedi's encounter with the Geonosian zombies prompted the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] and [[Coruscant Health Office/Legends|Coruscant Health Administration]] to issue a warning to the citizens of the Republic concerning the supposed "mystery infection" that was plaguing the Geonosians, urging caution for all inter-planetary travel.{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/dangernews20091124/index.html|text=A Public Service Announcement from the Galactic Republic}} While the Jedi ushered the captured Poggle onto a [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Nu''-class attack shuttle]] at a landing area in preparation to take him to Coruscant for trial, Mundi received word that Mace Windu's [[Battle of Dantooine (Clone Wars)|defenses]] on the planet [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] had been able to hold out, albeit at a great cost to his men; Windu immediately required medical supplies that were waiting to be delivered from a [[Ord Cestus medical station/Legends|medical station]] near the planet [[Ord Cestus/Legends|Ord Cestus]]. However, Skywalker and Unduli believed that it was also of immediate importance to transport Poggle to Coruscant, as the Republic had to begin debriefing him if any useful Separatist intelligence was to be gained from him. In order to allow himself and the other Jedi Generals to continue with the impending task of transporting Poggle to Coruscant, Skywalker proposed that Tano and Offee handle the medical supply mission, and the other Jedi Generals agreed. Kenobi assigned the Padawans to take a medical [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] to the medcenter, planning to rendezvous with them alongside Mundi, Unduli, and Skywalker for the voyage to Dantooine after delivering Poggle to Coruscant. After Tano and Offee departed for the Ord Cestus facility with the [[Pelta-class frigate/Legends|''Pelta''-class frigate]] [[TB-73/Legends|''TB-73'']] and clone troopers of Tango [[Company/Legends|Company]] as their embarked troops,{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode208.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Brain Invaders}} the four Jedi Generals and Captain Rex left with Poggle under heavy guard aboard a ''Venator''-class Star Destroyer, bound for Coruscant. The Padawans' routine mission, however, suddenly became a [[Skirmish aboard TB-73/Legends|dire fight]] for survival{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20091202/index.html|text=Friends Become Foes in ''The Clone Wars''}} when Geonosian brain worms—having infected Tango Company trooper [[Scythe (clone trooper)/Legends|Scythe]] at the remains of the Progate Temple—attempted to take control of their supply ship. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|So in the end, the Geonosian arc, what it really did in the bigger picture of ''The Clone Wars'' was it forced us to work on a scale we'd never worked on before. We did different types of episodes that ranged from massive action to almost horror-type episodes. We were dealing with new Jedi Knight Ki-Adi-Mundi. We were dealing with better effects in the flamethrower. We introduced the character of Poggle, we were dealing with more in-depth story arcs overall, so all in all Geonosis represents a landmark for us in ''The Clone Wars'', but it's just really now a shadow of the things that were to come.|Series Director [[Dave Filoni]]|[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Two|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Two]], "Return to Geonosis" DVD Featurette}} The Second Battle of Geonosis{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/holidaymarathon2009/index.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Season Two Holiday Marathon on StarWars.com}} was the first major battle of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series' [[2009]] [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]], following the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]] featured in the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]].{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20090225.html|text=A Battle Over Ryloth Begins an Epic, Three-Part Struggle}} It marked the Jedi's return to Geonosis after the First Battle of Geonosis and was featured across three chapters of a five-part story arc in the season{{SWArchive|url=bestof/bestof2009/index.html|text=''Star Wars'': The Best of 2009}}—"[[Landing at Point Rain]]," "[[Weapons Factory]]," and "[[Legacy of Terror]]," which began airing on [[November 4]], 2009 and continued until [[November 20]]. The three episodes were followed by the conclusion of the saga, "[[Brain Invaders]]," and were preceded by the episode "[[Senate Spy]]," which led into the battle by detailing the Republic's discovery of the droid foundries. In [[December]] [[2010]], the battle received its very own mini-game, entitled the "Geonosis Saga," as part of the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'' video game]]. Besides expanding upon various aspects of the campaign, the game clarified the [[canon]]ical significance of Point Rain as the Republic's landing zone, which was not established in "Landing at Point Rain" despite the allusion to it. [[File:SecondGeonosis-Scale.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Second Battle of Geonosis was a testament to the scale of the television series' animation.]] The battle's span over several television episodes allowed for various pre-existing characters to be introduced into the television series, notably Jedi Master Ki-Adi-Mundi, Jedi Padawan Barriss Offee, and Geonosian Archduke Poggle the Lesser. "Landing at Point Rain," the first chapter in the story arc, was added within the second season's production schedule at Series Producer [[George Lucas]]'s request for the conflict to begin with inspiration from the [[Wikipedia:Normandy landings|Normandy D-day landings]] of [[Wikipedia:World War II|World War II]].{{SW|url=video/landing-at-point-rain-episode-featurette|text="Landing at Point Rain" Episode Featurette}} "Landing at Point Rain" itself was used to look at the Jedi's challenges from the war with injuries on the parts of Mundi and Obi-Wan Kenobi. Overall, the battle was meant to recall the visual sense from classic war films such as [[Wikipedia:The Longest Day (film)|''The Longest Day'']], [[Wikipedia:Blackhawk Down (film)|''Blackhawk Down'']], and [[Wikipedia:Saving Private Ryan|''Saving Private Ryan'']]. The battle represented a major milestone for the television series, from showcasing the visual scale and detail that the series' production team was able to reach in modeling Season Two's animation, to representing the depth and variety that the series' writing team was able to achieve in the story arc's individual yet cohesive plot lines. As of the Spring [[2011]] conclusion to the television series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]], the Second Battle of Geonosis has been named by ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' as one of the largest engagements seen in the series, with the others being the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]], the Battle of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], and the [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|Battle of Kamino]].{{InsiderCite|125|50 Great Reasons to Rewatch Star Wars: The Clone Wars Season Three|50 Great Reasons to Rewatch ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Season Three}} Several aspects of the battle, including the destruction of the super tanks, were modified before the battle's storyline reached its final version. In "Weapons Factory," Anakin Skywalker and Luminara Unduli were to originally place their thermal detonators directly on the super tanks to destroy them, but at Lucas's instruction, they instead placed their explosive charges under the bridge that the tanks were crossing, thereby eliminating them by compromising the pass. ===Inconsistencies=== Although the "Daily Trivia" mini-game of the ''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'' [[Star Wars video games|video game]], as well as [[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 24|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' Part 24]], stated that the portion of the battle featured in "Legacy of Terror" was a separate conflict,{{TCWA|Daily Trivia}}{{FactFile2014|24|KAR 1-2|Queen Karina the Great}} this was not supported by the television series, which did not provide any further division for the battle. In fact, the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]'' maintained that the "Legacy of Terror" portion was part of the battle. This article therefore follows the television series' interpretation of events. In addition, there were initially some problems with the battle's official name, with a preview article for the episode "Brain Invaders" published on [[StarWars.com]] introducing difficulties with the naming of the battle. The article in question referred to the battle as the "Battle of Geonosis," a title that had already been adopted for the opening battle of the Clone Wars. Another article later published on StarWars.com resolved the conflict, officially giving the battle the "Second Battle of Geonosis" name. The original Battle of Geonosis was later identified as the "First Battle of Geonosis," making a clearer distinction between the two battles. Additionally, the "battle of Point Rain" name was provided in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.5|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic'' 6.5]] magazine.[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.5|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Comic 6.5]] The Second Battle of Geonosis was initially dated to [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] in ''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]'',''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]'' but the [[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 8|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' Part 8]] later incorrectly labeled its page covering the battle as "22 BBY 1-2"—an issue that was later corrected by the [[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 121|final issue]] of the series, which provided stickers to relabel the page as "21 BBY 1-2" correctly.[[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 121|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' Part 121]] The young readers' books [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: What Is a Sith Warrior?|''What Is a Sith Warrior?'']] and [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Who Are the Jedi?|''Who Are the Jedi?'']] placed the Second Battle of Geonosis prior to the later [[Battle of Malastare/Legends|Battle of Malastare]],''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: What Is a Sith Warrior?]]''''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Who Are the Jedi?]]'' which is inconsistent with the timeline of events established by [[Holocron continuity database]] manager [[Leland Chee]] for [[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide: Updated and Expanded|''The Ultimate Visual Guide: Updated and Expanded'']],''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide: Updated and Expanded]]'' in which the Battle of Malastare comes first. It is therefore assumed that the young readers' books are in error. The 2011 ''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]'' video game features the Second Battle of Geonosis in several of its playable missions. In addition to portraying the battle in a more comical and humorous manner, the game modifies some of the battle's storylines. During the frontal assault on Poggle the Lesser's primary droid foundry, the Jedi take a BARC speeder to cross the bridge to the foundry, and several cannons and enemy bases guarding the factory must be destroyed to ensure success. In the main versions of the game, Ahsoka Tano and Barriss Offee do not plant explosive charges at the factory's reactor; instead, they directly commandeer the super tank to destroy the facility's core.''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]'' In the [[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] edition of the game, Tano and Offee engage the factory's defenses on the way to the reactor. Once there, they are able to plant their explosive charges without interference from the Geonosians, and then they simply commandeer the super tank to complete their mission. During Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi's mission to free Luminara Unduli from underneath the Progate Temple, they must engage both Poggle the Lesser and Karina the Great in combat and defeat
